eligible_repairs: container or dependency correction without a security exception
eligibility_rule: A repair may change only how the exact already-authorized Slot 01 experiment is made operational; it may not change what the owner authorized.
required_repair_chain: run focused, full deterministic, safety, and synthetic M1-M5 tests
build successor artifact only if required
publish once through the existing bounded publisher only if required
obtain actual registry digest and prove representation equivalence
require provider scan COMPLETE with critical/high/blocking 0/0/0
generate an ADR-0075-compliant saved Terraform plan only if required
perform synthetic postdeployment validation with zero 903hvac.com access
resume the same immutable Slot 01 experiment
mandatory_owner_stop_conditions: material request, time, byte, or cost ceiling increase
outreach, delivery, sending, or external communication
weakened robots, TLS, SSRF, DNS-rebinding, minimization, provenance, or truth control
security vulnerability exception or nonzero blocking scan finding
any finite repair, elapsed-time, or cost bound exceeded

transport_counter_rule.before_first_target_transport: eligible technical failures may be repaired and the same experiment resumed; every attempt remains immutable
transport_counter_rule.after_first_target_transport: all request, attempt, byte, and time counters remain cumulative across repairs and may never reset

terminal_cleanup: controlled egress dormant; lease, research release, and sampled-slot approval NOT_AUTHORIZED; kill switch TRIPPED; stop for human review
